import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('fhwa_drivers_licenses_2022.xlsx', sheet_name='TOTAL', header=None)
# States are from row index 14 to 64 (rows 15 to 65 in Excel)
states_df = df.iloc[14:65, [0, 16]].copy()
states_df.columns = ['state', 'total']
states_df['state'] = states_df['state'].astype(str).str.replace(r'\s*\(\d+\)', '', regex=True).str.strip()
states_df['total'] = pd.to_numeric(states_df['total'])
top3 = states_df.sort_values(by='total', ascending=False).head(3)
result = top3['state'].tolist()

import pandas as pd

males = pd.read_excel('fhwa_drivers_licenses_2022.xlsx', sheet_name='MALES', header=None)
females = pd.read_excel('fhwa_drivers_licenses_2022.xlsx', sheet_name='FEMALES', header=None)

# Total row is at row index 65 (row 66 in Excel), column P is index 15 (85 AND OVER)
male_total = float(males[males[0].astype(str).str.strip() == 'Total'][15].values[0])
female_total = float(females[females[0].astype(str).str.strip() == 'Total'][15].values[0])

result = round(abs(female_total - male_total), 3)
